name: Buggy Mess
storyline: Your friend want you to go buy the new game that just came out, you will need to get out of your cave (literally) to go touch grass uh… i mean go buy the game at the store.
summary: Buggy Mess is a short game where your friend wants you to go buy the new game that just came out, you will need to get out of your cave and go buy the game at the store. This game was originally made for the RE:START 2022 PSP Game jam.
